_published_faq.name: How do I add Excalidraw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Excalidraw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.excalidraw.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Excalidraw MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Excalidraw scores 78/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Excalidraw's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Excalidraw scores 46/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 5 of 5 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Excalidraw MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Excalidraw provides these MCP tools: read_me, create_view, export_to_excalidraw, save_checkpoint, and read_checkpoint.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Excalidraw?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Excalidraw in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Excalidraw does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can Excalidraw improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: save_checkpoint is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 27/100. 0 of 2 inputs have descriptions. Add descriptions to the missing inputs, including where to obtain IDs and how to supply values. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
Excalidraw is developed by Excalidraw. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
